title: Reviewing CDC Vouchers Eligibility in View of Distinct Family Nuclei Residing in Same Address for Caregiving Purposes
what_it_is: Reviewing CDC Vouchers Eligibility in View of Distinct Family Nuclei Residing in Same Address for Caregiving Purposes

sections.label: CDC Vouchers and caregiver support
sections.summary: The CDC Vouchers Scheme helps all Singaporean households with daily expenses and is complemented by other support schemes for caregivers and families.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Finance (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, the Community Development Council (CDC) Vouchers Scheme is a broad-based scheme designed to help all Singaporean households with daily expenses.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Finance (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The CDC Vouchers Scheme is complemented by schemes that support the different family circumstances of Singaporean households, such as the Assurance Package Cash, Child LifeSG Credits and the Silver Support Scheme for eligible households.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Finance (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: For caregivers, the Government has, over the years, increased subsidies for long-term care services and enhanced the Home Caregiving Grant and the Seniors’ Mobility and Enabling Fund to provide greater financial relief to caregivers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Finance (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Caregivers can also apply for the Migrant Domestic Worker Levy Concession if they need more help to care for their loved ones.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Finance (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The Government will continue to regularly review our measures to ensure Singaporeans in need of help will receive the appropriate support.

sections.label: Multi-generation households and CDC vouchers
sections.summary: A daughter caring full-time for a senior parent lives with her family, and such related households cannot appeal for CDC vouchers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Hamid Razak (West Coast-Jurong West)
sentences.text: For example, a daughter who has moved out of a place to live in with a senior mother or grandparent, and looking after them full-time with her own family, living with her young children.

sentences.speaker: Dr Hamid Razak (West Coast-Jurong West)
sentences.text: And because they are related, they are unable to appeal for the CDC vouchers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Hamid Razak (West Coast-Jurong West)
sentences.text: So, this household actually has a fair number of individuals living in a single registered address and they have to change the address because, legally, they are required to do so since they are living permanently with someone else.

sentences.speaker: Dr Hamid Razak (West Coast-Jurong West)
sentences.text: So, these households have maybe about eight to nine people each.

sections.label: Calibrating vouchers for larger households
sections.summary: If data shows more such households, a calibrated approach to CDC voucher quantum for larger households could be considered.

sentences.speaker: Dr Hamid Razak (West Coast-Jurong West)
sentences.text: Hopefully, if the data shows that there are growing number of households with such situations, one of the ways we can do is with what fellow Members have asked for during the course of the serious debates, to perhaps look at the number of persons in the household and maybe we can have a calibrated approach to the quantum of CDC vouchers given to larger households in Singapore.
